facts.fact: The document states a national workshop on 23 July 2026 reviewed the results (bilan) of the National Cybersecurity Strategy (SNCS) 2021-2025 and examined the draft for 2026-2030; only the 2021-2025 strategy is recorded, the 2026-2030 draft is not.
The document states ANSSI-CI, with a Director General and a supervisory board, organised the 23 July 2026 national workshop on the cybersecurity strategy.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI-CI)
